Martha [the code in src/, one directory per capability]
Every box is a directory in src/: the name is the capability, and its test sits beside it. These 19 directories are drawn nowhere on purpose:
check_the_workspace_layout: the entry npm run check:workspace-layout and the CI job run, over the scan check_the_workspace_matches_its_layout holds;
a host adapter may import no program, so the launch runs that slice and never this entry.
probe_launch_hosts: a script run by hand, npm run probe:launch, to probe a host; the command never loads it.
land_a_package_on_a_throwaway_repository: the live run's guards for its throwaway repository (martha#639); the command never loads them.
declare_a_launch_probe: what one row of npm run probe:launch is, shared by its rows and its runner; the command never loads it.
probe_a_checkouts_own_config: npm run probe:launch's rows about a checkout's own config; the command never loads them.
probe_the_owners_hooks: npm run probe:launch's rows about the owner's hooks; the command never loads them.
probe_the_owners_own_folders: npm run probe:launch's rows about the owner's own folders; the command never loads them.
probe_the_hosts_auto_memory: npm run probe:launch's rows about the host's auto-memory; the command never loads them.
drive_the_recorded_host: the harness the recorded-host tests drive: a recorded host stood up with a script, and the waits its runs need; no member ever loads it.
pin_what_a_read_carries: the recorded-host case that pins which instruction text a host attaches to a session, run by node --test and ci.yml's relay job; no
record_mesh_answers: a script run by hand, npm run record:mesh-answers, when a version of the mesh server is recorded; the gate reads the answers it wrote,
record_claude_code_host: a script run by hand, npm run record:claude-code-host, when the host is upgraded; the adapter reads what it writes, and never runs it.
compare_two_host_recordings: what two recordings of the host say once the minifier's names are taken out (martha#811); only record_claude_code_host
follow_what_host_code_calls: the definitions a recorded text of the host reaches in its bundle (martha#811); only record_claude_code_host loads it, to record
record_the_goose_engine: a script run by hand, npm run record:goose-engine, when the Goose engine moves to a new version (martha#541); the daily engine
drift job runs its --check, and no member ever loads it.
stand_in_for_an_openai_model: a model behind an OpenAI-compatible URL, answered from a script, for runs of the Goose engine with no model (martha#541);
tests and npm run stand-in:openai-model load it, and no member ever does.
stand_in_for_an_acp_agent: an ACP agent on stdio answered from a script, offering the recorded Goose engine's permission answers, for the tests of
speak_acp_to_an_agent (martha#541); tests and npm run stand-in:acp-agent load it, and no member ever does.
check_no_member_outlives_its_run: a script run by hand, npm run check:no-member-outlives-its-run, over this machine's /proc;
find_a_member_a_run_left_behind is what it reads with, and martha ls shows the same lines without loading the program.
check_no_member_works_without_its_crew_tools: a script run by hand and as a CI job, npm run check:no-member-works-without-its-crew-tools, over this
machine's Martha state; it reads the windows keep_a_members_crew_tools_window keeps, and no member ever loads it.
The crew ledger is drawn in the crew's own box because a lockup now loads it. record_mesh_server_tools is drawn because the launcher imports what it
recorded; the room itself is not built, and solo admits nothing, though every launch loads the node id, the tool list and the gates its slices hold.
